anbieter.admin: Sign in with a password (for everyone who administers)
vergessen.text: Enter your email address. You’ll get a link to set a new password.
vergessen.ohne-mail: No email sending is set up for this installation. Ask the person who administers Ablago to create a new link for you in user management.
vergessen.gesendet: If there is an account for this address, an email is on its way. The link in it is valid for one hour.
code.text: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
code.text.wiederherstellung: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
code.wechsel.wiederherstellung: No phone at hand? Use a recovery code
code.verbraucht.titel: Signed in with a recovery code
code.verbraucht.text: This code is now used up. Have you lost your phone or got a new one? Set up two-factor sign-in again under My account → Security, or create new recovery codes.
zweifaktor.text: For your role, a code from an app on your phone is required in addition to the password. Set it up now – it takes a minute.
zweifaktor.pflicht.hinweis: Because you may administer Ablago, you can also withdraw the requirement:
zweifaktor.pflicht.knopf: Turn off the requirement for administrators
zweifaktor.pflicht.frage: Turn off the requirement for everyone who may administer?
zweifaktor.pflicht.frage.text: Anyone who may administer then signs in with just the password again. Nobody else is affected. You can set up two-factor sign-in later under My account → Security.
passwort.willkommen.name: Welcome, {name}
fehler.falsch: Email address or password is wrong.
fehler.anbieter.unbekannt: There is no account in Ablago for {email}. Ask the person who administers Ablago to create one for you.
fehler.abgelaufen: The sign-in has expired. Please start again with the password.
fehler.passwort.kurz: The password needs at least {anzahl} characters.
fehler.email: Please enter a valid email address.
fehler.link.abgelaufen: This link has expired or has already been used. Please request a new one.
fehler.link.ungueltig: This link is no longer valid.
fehler.link.benutzt: This link has already been used.
